description: This is a unit test class for the TimeDate class within the SuiteCRM project. It tests various methods related to date and time formatting, user preferences, and time manipulation functions.

classes.name: TimeDateTest
classes.description: Unit test class for TimeDate, covering date/time format retrieval, merging/splitting formats, and conversions.

methods.name: testget_date_format
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the date format from user preferences.

methods.name: testget_time_format
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the time format from user preferences.

methods.name: testget_date_time_format
methods.description: Tests retrieval of combined date-time format from user preferences.

methods.name: testget_first_day_of_week
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the first day of the week setting from user preferences.

methods.name: testget_first_day_of_week_defaultResponse
methods.description: Tests default behavior when no user is specified.

methods.name: testmerge_date_time
methods.description: Tests merging of date and time format strings.

methods.name: testsplit_date_time
methods.description: Tests splitting of date-time string into date and time parts.

methods.name: testhttpTime
methods.description: Tests generation of RFC 2616 formatted timestamp.

methods.name: testto_db_time
methods.description: Tests extracting time part from a datetime string, regardless of date.

methods.name: testto_db_date_time
methods.description: Tests conversion of separate date and time inputs into a full datetime array.

methods.name: testsplitTime
methods.description: Tests splitting of time string into hours, minutes, seconds.

methods.name: testsplitTimeWith24HourDateTime
methods.description: Tests splitting of a datetime with 24-hour time into components.

methods.name: testsplitTimeWithPM
methods.description: Tests splitting of a datetime with AM/PM notation into components, including AM/PM indicator.
